correctness.rationale: Complete enumerations of the 20 icosahedral triangles and all 1,047 faces give 112 maximal six-vertex simplices. A vertex-pivot discrete Morse pairing has 522 pairs, and a directed topological sort of all 4,344 incidences verifies global acyclicity. Only cells in dimensions 0,4,5 remain. Two independently implemented exact signed integer cancellation recurrences produce Morse boundary -2. The model is S^4 with a five-cell attached by degree 2; its reduced integral fourth homology is Z/2 and all other reduced homology vanishes. Modular chain computations over 2,3,5,7 corroborate but are not used as an infinite or integral proof.

value.rationale: The icosahedral graph is a canonical highly symmetric planar triangulation outside known chordal clique-free shellability results. The pure five-dimensional complex has nontrivial Z/2 fourth homology and a degree-two top attachment, a structural obstruction not visible from rational homology ranks or standard shellability theorems. A fully explicit finite integer certificate supplies a meaningful torsion benchmark for topology of nonchordal clique-free complexes, not an arbitrary subgraph slice.
